arabic text: SUNO SUNO, SHAB-E-ASHOOR KA YE MANZAR HAI, HAAY HAAY HAAY\nSIRHAANE BHAAYI KE BETHI, ALI KI DUKHTAR HAI, HAAY HAAY HAAY
english translation text: HEAR HEAR, THIS IS THE SITUATION ON THE EVE OF ASHURA, OH OH OH\nSITTING NEXT TO HER BROTHER, IS ALI’S (A.S) DAUGHTER, OH OH OH

arabic text: WO KEHRAHI HAI MERA SABR, AZMAAOGE\nAY MERE BHAAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: SHE SAYS, ARE YOU TESTING THE LEVEL OF MY PATIENCE?\nO MY BROTHER HUSSAIN

arabic text:
QADAM QADAM PE MUJHE BHAAYI YAAD AAWOGE
SAHAR KO NANA KA WADA
JO TUM NIBHAAWOGE
AY MERE BHAAYI HUSSAIN
QADAM QADAM PE MUJHE BHAAYI YAAD AAWOGE
english translation text:
I WILL REMEMBER YOU AT EVERY MOMENT, O’ BROTHER
THE PROMISE MADE TO GRANDFATHER, YOU WILL FULFIL TOMORROW
O MY BROTHER HUSSAIN
I WILL REMEMBER YOU AT EVERY MOMENT, O’ BROTHER

arabic text: MERI NIGAAH MEI BACHPAN KI SARI YAADE HAI\nKAHI THI NANA NE JO YAAD WO BHI BAATE HAI\nSAHAR SE PEHLE CHARAGHO(N) KO TUM BUJHAAWOGE
english translation text: ALL THE MEMORIES OF OUR CHILDHOOD ARE IN MY VISION\nI EVEN REMEMBER WHAT OUR GRANDFATHER TOLD US\n>WHEN, BEFORE DAWN YOU EXTINGUISH THE LANTERNS

arabic text: AY MERE BHAAYI HUSSAIN\nQADAM QADAM PE MUJHE BHAAYI YAAD AAWOGE
english translation text: O MY BROTHER HUSSAIN\nI WILL REMEMBER YOU AT EVERY MOMENT, O’ BROTHER

arabic text: TUMHARE CHEHRE KA YE ITMINAAN JAANTI HU\nTUMHARA HONA HAI JO IMTIHAAN JAANTI HU\nBAHAN SE DARD-E-JIGAR KO CHUPA NA PAAOGE
english translation text: I RECOGNIZE THIS CONTENTMENT UPON YOUR FACE\nI KNOW THE TRIAL THAT YOU MUST ENDURE\nYOU CANNOT HIDE THE HEARTACHE FROM YOUR SISTER

arabic text: AY MERE BHAAYI HUSSAIN\nQADAM QADAM PE MUJHE BHAAYI YAAD AAWOGE
english translation text: O MY BROTHER HUSSAIN\nI WILL REMEMBER YOU AT EVERY MOMENT, O’ BROTHER

arabic text: GULOO-E-ASGHAR-E-BESHEER SINA-E-AKBAR\nSATA RAHA HAI TUMHE SABR KAR RAHE HO MAGAR\nRIDA KE BAAT PE NAZRE MILA NA PAAOGE
english translation text: THE NECK OF THE INFANT, ASGHAR, AND THE CHEST OF AKBAR\nARE CAUSING YOU PAIN BUT YOU ARE BEING PATIENT\nBUT YOU WILL NOT BEAR THE TALK OF MY CHADAR(HIJAB)

arabic text: AY MERE BHAAYI HUSSAIN\nQADAM QADAM PE MUJHE BHAAYI YAAD AAWOGE
english translation text: O MY BROTHER HUSSAIN\nI WILL REMEMBER YOU AT EVERY MOMENT, O’ BROTHER

arabic text: ABHI TO BALI SAKINA KA ZIKR BAQI HAI\nABHI TO SHAM-E-GHARIBAN KI FIKR BAQI HAI\nRAKHONGE YAAD KISSE KISKO BHOOL JAAWOGE
english translation text: THE MENTION OF YOUNG SAKINA REMAINS\nTHE WORRIES OF SHAM-E-GHARIBAN REMAINS\nWHO WILL YOU REMEMBER, AND WHO WILL YOU FORGET?

arabic text: AY MERE BHAAYI HUSSAIN\nQADAM QADAM PE MUJHE BHAAYI YAAD AAWOGE
english translation text: O MY BROTHER HUSSAIN\nI WILL REMEMBER YOU AT EVERY MOMENT, O’ BROTHER

arabic text: NA GHAM KARO MERE BHAAYI TUMHARE BAAD BAHAN\nRIDA NA ORHENGE JAB TAK TUMHE MILE NA KAFAN\nYE DUKH HAI SAATH HAMARE WATAN NA JAAWOGE
english translation text: BE NOT SORROWFUL O BROTHER, FOR AFTER YOU, YOUR SISTER\nSHALL NOT COVER HERSELF IN A VEIL UNTIL YOU GET A SHROUD\nMY GRIEF IS THAT YOU WILL NOT RETURN HOME WITH US

arabic text: AY MERE BHAAYI HUSSAIN\nQADAM QADAM PE MUJHE BHAAYI YAAD AAWOGE
english translation text: O MY BROTHER HUSSAIN\nI WILL REMEMBER YOU AT EVERY MOMENT, O’ BROTHER

arabic text: KAHAA(N) HUSSAIN NE SUNKAR, KALAAM ZAINAB KA\nHAMARI JAAN KE BADLE BACHE TERA PARDA\nYE KYA KAHAA(N) KE MERA SABR AZMAAOGE
english translation text: ON HEARING ZAINAB'S LAMENTATION, HUSSAIN SAID\nIN LIEU OF MY LIFE, MAY YOUR VEIL BE SAVED!\nWHAT HAVE YOU JUST SAID - A TRIAL OF MY FORBEARANCE!

arabic text: AY MERE BHAAYI HUSSAIN\nQADAM QADAM PE MUJHE BHAAYI YAAD AAWOGE
english translation text: O MY BROTHER HUSSAIN\nI WILL REMEMBER YOU AT EVERY MOMENT, O’ BROTHER

arabic text: TERE BAGHAYR MUQAMMAL NAHI PAYAAM MERA\nTERE BAGHAYR ADHURA HAI AB TO NAAM MERA\nKAHO(N) MEI AAWUNGI MAJLIS MEI JAB BULAAWOGE
english translation text: WITHOUT YOU, MY MESSAGE IS INCOMPLETE\nWITHOUT YOU, MY NAME IS INCOMPLETE\nSAY: I SHALL ATTEND YOUR MAJLIS WHENEVER YOU INVITE ME

arabic text: AY MERE BHAAYI HUSSAIN\nQADAM QADAM PE MUJHE BHAAYI YAAD AAWOGE
english translation text: O MY BROTHER HUSSAIN\nI WILL REMEMBER YOU AT EVERY MOMENT, O’ BROTHER

arabic text: YE GUFTUGU THI KE GUNJI AZAAN-E-AKBAR KI\n'REHAN' HOTI THI YALGAAR SHEH PE LASHKAR KI\nALI KI BETI PUKAARI HAME RULAAWOGE
english translation text: THUS WENT THE CONVERSATION, WHEN THE ADHAN OF AKBAR ECHOED\nTHE ARMIES THEN CEASELESSLY ATTACKED THE KING (HUSSAIN)\nTHE DAUGHTER OF ALI CALLED OUT: YOU SHALL MAKE US WEEP!
